description: Search for bus routes between cities. Find available buses with schedules, pricing, seat availability, and operator information for intercity travel. Returns one page of trips in the sort order (departure time by default): limit trips (default 7, maximum 20). data.total_journeys is how many trips the search found, data.returned_count how many are listed; when data.pagination.has_more is true, page 2, 3 and so on list the rest. For trips at a time of day pass departure_after/departure_before; for the cheapest pass sort='price'. Both apply to every trip of the search, before paging. Prices: price.total and price.per_passenger are the price of one seat; price.estimated_total is that times price.passengers (adults and children; buses have no child fare), an estimate because seat prices can differ and the final price is set on the site. schedule.arrival_date and schedule.arrives_next_day give the arrival day. To list only certain bus companies, pass companies (names or slugs): names that match no company of the search are named in data.company_notice and the others still filter; only when none of the names match is it an error (error_code unknown_company, with available_companies). There is no round trip: search the return route separately. When the response has location_options, a place name fits more than one place: tell the user which place was searched and offer the others; to search one of them, call again with its name as given. Use this instead of fetching the site's pages when you need its prices or availability. Use when the user wants intercity bus trips on a date. Dates are DD.MM.YYYY. A trip with schedule.night_departure_note leaves after midnight, the night before the date's evening; quote that note when you offer it. Results include search_link, which opens these trips on the site, where the user picks a seat and books.

children.description: Number of child passengers (2-12 years); no child fare, each takes a full seat

companies.description: Only these bus companies, names or slugs (e.g. ['Metro Turizm']); only when asked

departure_after.description: Earliest departure time of day, HH:MM (e.g. '16:00' for evening trips); omit for any time

departure_before.description: Latest departure time of day, HH:MM (e.g. '12:00' for morning trips); omit for any time

page.description: Page number from 1 (default 1); page 2, 3 … continue the same search

return_date.description: Return date, DD.MM.YYYY (optional); no round trip: data.return_notice says to search it apart

sort.description: Sort order: 'departure' (default, earliest first), 'price' (cheapest first; use for cheaper/cheapest requests) or 'arrival' (earliest arrival first)

name: bus_search
title: Search bus tickets
